#home work - good Teacher#
@所有人 请今天参会的各位老师
每个人出一份md，“我们怎么评价好老师”和AI讨论后的相对完整的框架/设计，请大家分享给我，我会让我的AI“cook”一下，把各个版本的特点都吸收出来，做出一份“大拼盘”给供我们下次定稿，辛苦大家. 请下周一之前

please write one Markdown file on this question: "How do we evaluate and indentify a good teacher?" Share the framework or design you arrived at after discussing it with AI — as complete as you can get it.

Send yours to me. I'll have my AI "cook" them all together, pull out the strengths of each version, and build one combined draft for us to finalize at our next session.

Thanks, everyone. by the end of Monday noon please
